verdict.rationale: Linear's developer docs mention 'Import data from other services into Linear' as a capability, and community comments confirm teams migrated from Jira to Linear, but there is no detail on which tools are supported, fidelity of imported data, or a hands-on account of the import process. missing for 10: documented list of supported source tools, description of what data (issues, comments, attachments, history) is preserved, and independent verification of import quality/success.
